question: P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. T is not an immediate neighbour of P. Only 3 people sit between P and R when counted from the right of P. V sits immediately to the left of S. Q sits 2nd to the left of R. Who sits 2nd to the left of T?
solution:
Given:

P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only 3 people sit between P and R when counted from the right of P.

2) Q sits 2nd to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dfdf37a346ed569596a2796b2b8f7221a3a5f14caa897633340080bcc067461.png] 

3) V sits immediately to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38d15b404017b3868ed34adbb08715fa5eda342b1f757138d64148dc354f54c6.png] 

4) T is not an immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7b333581505a10594adde4608b28523828520714abe71a2e08adab8d7404837.png] 

So, 'U' sits 2nd to the left of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (4).**"
